title: CC: Reimagined
description: A reimagining of the classic ComputerCraft look and feel!
body:
![A full spread of the block textures in the pack. Displayed text reads "ComputerCraft: Reimagined" on the left and "A resource pack by crazymachinefan" on the right. crazymachinefan is in red text. Blocks from left to right, top to bottom: Monitor (front), Network Cable, Advanced Monitor (front), Monitor (side), Monitor (back), Modem (block, peripheral attached), Card Reader (formerly Disk Drive, green status light is on), Speaker, Advanced Monitor (back), Advanced Monitor (side), Printer (fully loaded), Modem (panel, channel open), Network Cable (again), Redstone Relay, Turtle, Melee Turtle (holding a pride flag), Computer, Advanced Computer (with RGB lights), Command Computer, Modem (block, off), Advanced Noisy Turtle (holding a trans flag), Advanced Crafty Turtle. All components have a black base. Normal components have a grey top, advanced components have a gold top.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a3a34d30bf521877f78a293ab6be368db1851ae.png)

It's ComputerCraft, but reimagined! This resource pack aims to bring the classic look of the mod into the modern Minecraft era with _more than a few_ creative liberties along the way.

Notable features include:
- Fancy RGB lighting on the Advanced Computer
- Blinkenlights on all the network cabling
- Emissives, since it's apparantly a feature of the mod
- Custom turtle models
- Floppy Disks have been replaced with Memory Cards
- Animated textures on some blocks

![The items of the resource pack, as well as turtles. Left to right, top to bottom: Red pocket computer, wired modem, wireless modem, ender modem, pink memory card, pink turtle with an ender modem, pocket computer, advanced pocket computer, printed sheet, pile of printed sheets, printed book, white turtle with a wireless modem, normal turtle with a pride flag and sword, back of normal turtle with a pickaxe, advanced turtle with a trans flag, back of advanced turtle, side of red turtle with a crafting table, side of light blue turtle with a speaker](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SNFsKC51/images/9dcc182a3f1fd7f0582a4936c2cb4b06eb0e3c61.png)

<details>
<summary>Known issues and future plans (no guarantees)</summary>
Emissives for turtle radios don't work. No clue how to fix it.
  
Turtle radios don't animate unless there's a radio placed in the world.

Not sure if I like the turtle crafting upgrade texture.

Not sure if I like the wired modem texture.

Wired modem emissives are unimplemented. This is because I don't feel like it

Not sure if the santa turtle model works, it's not christmas right now

There's occasional Z-fighting on the advanced computer because of how I did the RGB

I'd like to at least recolor some of the UIs at some point in the future

If someone could tell me if the MIT license is acceptable for this project that would be great
</details>
